capability: 7-baseline named-baseline benchmark for coating scratch hardness on real experimental Purformance HTE 2K polyurethane lacquer data (86 formulations, LOIO CV). Directly answers the red-team challenge 'does your ML beat classical coating chemistry Rule 1 (hardness ~ crosslink density)?'. HONEST FINDING: physical Vernetzung-only baseline (Wicks-Jones-Pappas 2007 Rule 1) barely beats constant (R² = +0.0156), because crosslinking alone does not explain scratch hardness in modern DoE-formulated coatings — HDI-IPDI ratio, matting agent, and pigment paste all contribute. Full HistGBM ML R² = +0.8555 dominates by +0.8400 R² over the physical baseline. Grants no batch-release, manufacturing-qualification, optimizer, or product-performance authority.

metrics.name: full_ml_r2_beats_vernetzung_only_physical_crosslinking_baseline
metrics.note: Full ML (+0.8555) beats Vernetzung-only linear regression (+0.0156) by +0.8400 R². Physical baseline: coating hardness ~ crosslink density (Wicks-Jones-Pappas 2007 Ch. 24 Rule 1). HONEST FINDING: Vernetzung-only baseline barely beats constant (R²=+0.016), meaning crosslinking density ALONE does not explain scratch hardness — HDI-IPDI ratio, matting agent, and pigment paste all contribute substantially. Classical coating chemistry Rule 1 is necessary but insufficient.

population: Purformance HTE 2K polyurethane lacquer dataset (Cordts et al., Chem. Mater. 2024, Zenodo 13742098): 86 real experimental formulations across 3 sequential DoE iterations. y_stats: mean 14.70 N, std 3.05 N. Features: Vernetzung (crosslinking density), HDI-IPDI ratio, matting agent, pigment paste.
split_methodology: Pooled 3-fold leave-one-iteration-out (LOIO) cross-validation matching parent scratch hardness receipt protocol. Every baseline trained on 2 iterations and evaluated on the held-out iteration; pooled across all 3 folds.
theory: Cordts, Sassmannshausen, Rendel, Klein, Reddemann, Berge 2024 Chem. Mater. — Purformance dataset provenance
Wicks, Jones, Pappas 2007 Organic Coatings 3rd ed. Wiley Ch. 24 — coating hardness ~ crosslink density (Rule 1)
